text: Recorded real run — every number below was measured, none simulated for display.
GPU pool MI300X rented at $2.19/hr (GPU) — billing started, serving not yet up.
GPU pool A100 rented at $1.39/hr (GPU) — billing started, serving not yet up.
Bench started: real streamed traffic against the pool — $/Mtok is derived from measured tokens/sec at the declared $/hr.
Certifying: grounding + rubric parity on the shadow log, p99 SLO from the bench report, ed25519 signature.
Synthetic load started: the 12 eval questions replay through the router; the primary answers the client while every request is mirrored to the candidate — the shadow log is the cert evidence.
PROMOTED — the route's primary swapped to the GPU candidate; clients now get its answers.
ROLLED BACK — the incumbent serves again; the release engine recorded both transitions.
MI300X pod terminated from the console — the ledger entry closes; per-second billing stops.
A100 pod terminated from the console — the ledger entry closes; per-second billing stops.
